declaration.conformal_frame: working gauge b = 1/a; no physical frame declared
declaration.generator: normalized field-dependent chi = N d_t with N = u = beta*(2 - 3*beta*gamma), unique up to component sign (future-directedness) and f(J) reparametrization
declaration.horizon_condition: any simple root of B; first law certified modulo B(r_h) = 0 at every root
declaration.infinity_condition: fixed-falloff ensembles {gamma, k fixed} audited against the residual group
declaration.phase_space: static parameter slice; variations d_beta, d_gamma, d_k only
declaration.theory: pure-Weyl gravity L = alpha C_abcd C^abcd

ensemble_audit.c_preservation: the only residual c preserving a fixed-falloff ensemble {gamma, k fixed} is c = 0
ensemble_audit.dilation_preservation: lambda = 1 unless gamma = k = 0; on the Schwarzschild sub-ensemble the dilation acts freely and consistently (H = 0, S constant)
ensemble_audit.global_admissibility: the c-map factor Omega = 1/(1 + c*r) is smooth and positive on an exterior [r_h, r_out] iff 1 + c*r > 0 there, i.e. c > -1/r_out; on any fixed-falloff ensemble the residual directions are frozen anyway
ensemble_audit.nonzero_c_locus: u*(w**2 - 3) = 0 with w = 1 - 3*beta*gamma; w**2 = 3 is never satisfied at rational parameters, u = 0 degenerates the normalization

first_law.multi_horizon_identity: T_i dS_i = dH for every horizon r_i simultaneously; verified exactly at the fixture roots 1, 3, 8
first_law.no_extra_terms: no boundary source or pressure-volume term is needed on the static family in this normalization
first_law.statement: dH - T dS = 0 identically modulo B(r_h) = 0, in all three parameter directions, at every simple root

hamiltonian.basic_on_quotient: dH ^ dJ = 0: H is functionally dependent on the single residual invariant J
hamiltonian.discriminant_relation: J = -u**2*D1*D2, so H vanishes exactly on the D2-branch of the degenerate-horizon locus
hamiltonian.einstein_control_ensemble: Schwarzschild-(A)dS slice gamma = 0: H = -64*pi*alpha*beta**2*k; one-boundary AdS control has k < 0

horizon_fixture.first_law_directional_test: dH = T dS verified exactly at r = 1, 3, 8 in all three parameter directions

missing_objects: presymplectic form and charges for time-dependent perturbations (full BH-1)
uniqueness of the normalized generator among non-static candidates
physical matter/clock frame and its horizon regularity
any stability, ringdown, or quantum statement

normalization.bare_control: d F != 0 for N = 1 (bare form remains nonintegrable)
normalization.basicness: iota and Lie derivative of u F vanish for both residual generators
normalization.closure: d(u F) = 0 exactly on the full static family
normalization.field_dependent_correction: for spacetime-constant N the Q_{delta chi} correction cancels the dN terms exactly, so the corrected charge form is N*F
normalization.orientation_caveat: sign(u) = sign(2 - 3*beta*gamma); use N = -u on components with u < 0 for a future-directed generator (all charges flip sign)
normalization.why: basicness: N must be c-invariant with dilation weight -1; the invariant ring forces N = u*f(J)

wald_entropy.construction: S = -2*pi Int E^{abcd} eps_ab eps_cd dA with E = 2*alpha*C^{abcd}, eps_tr = 1
wald_entropy.schwarzschild_value: 64*pi**2*alpha, mass-independent, consistent with H = 0 on that ensemble
